name: Principled Uncertainty Pruning
aliases: PUP 3D-GS (Principled Uncertainty Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting)
Principled Uncertainty Pruning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: The pruning score is the log determinant of the block diagonal element of the Fisher Information matrix corresponding to a single Gaussian's parameters, interpreted as the entropy of a second-order Laplace approximation of the posterior distribution over that Gaussian.
